program: Geiger Boulevard Infrastructure Improvement Project: non-federal match (WSDOT, Spokane County, City of Spokane, West Plains PDA)

County project page returned Cloudflare block, so no county primary document saved.

facility_desc: Spokane fulfillment center, 10010 W Geiger Blvd
program: West Plains Public Development Authority county-city tax revenue sharing agreement (incremental tax revenue split 50/50 county/city, PDA keeps share)
issuer: Spokane County Commissioners / Spokane City Council (per Spokesman-Review)
notes: General area agreement, not an Amazon-specific award. Article says PDA revenue predicted about $400,000/yr for six years; no amount attributable to Amazon. Commissioner French: without the agreement "I don't think Amazon would be here" (opinion). Council vote of 2019-11-04 outcome not confirmed.
